answer: Each epoch the network’s onyx ledger issues a fresh, non‑deterministic reasoning challenge to every active identity, drawn from a decentralized grove of task generators. An agent must solve the challenge using its own model weights, producing a proof that is verified by surrounding peers before the identity is admitted to the haven of transaction rights. Because the challenge changes every round, an attacker must expend fresh compute for each counterfeit ID, making a Sybil attack scale linearly with the cost of running additional model inferences.
